mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, we are enjoying 80-degree weather with clear skies near Badger Ridge Middle School. Under the First Quarter moon tonight, keep your eyes peeled for the International Space Station at 9:33 PM; it will travel from the northwest near Verona High School toward Fitchburg in the east, reaching halfway up the sky.

For city updates, the VHAT cable channel is your home for government meetings and community info, available on channels 989 or 1989. Also, remember that composting your food scraps at home or at the Badger Prairie site helps the environment, and check with the Building Inspection Department regarding residential vehicle storage rules.

We have a packed schedule! Trivia kicks off at Hop Haus and Lake Louie this Tuesday, followed by the Downtown Farmers Market at Hometown Junction Park and Wednesday Trivia at The Bogey Factory. Don't forget live music at Paddy Mac's on Wednesday and Concerts in the Park on Thursday.
Looking at the weekly service report, officers handled a notable incident on July 13 when a driver was arrested for an OWI after their vehicle became trapped on a large rock.
You are in for a treat today with the Chocolate Caramel Twist flavor of the day at Culver's. The store is open until 10 PM tonight, so you have plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
